title: The Deathcord Elemental Hunger Games
description: Welcome to the Deathcord Elemental Hunger Games Modpack.  The Deathcord Elemental Hunger Games is a PvP style modpack, Made for min of 50 players. Each Player will Start with a random Element whether it Is  Earth or Air, water, fire.
body:
# **_Welcome to the Deathcord Elemental HungerGames_** In this arena, chance is the first rule. When a player enters your world for the very first time, the system marks them with a single, irreversible choice — not by their hand, but by fate. Earth. Water. Air. Fire. No rerolls. No second chances. Their identity is sealed before they even take their first step. This modpack turns your server into a controlled, unpredictable battleground built for large‑scale events where every participant must adapt to the element they’re given. No client mods. No commands. No prep. Just the arena, the players, and the tension of not knowing what the next opponent can do. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # **_🌪️ Core Features_** - Event‑Scale Player Capacity Designed for servers hosting 50–100 players, depending on hardware and configuration. - Random Element Assignment On first join, each player receives Earth, Water, Air, or Fire. The element is stored and remains consistent for the entire event. - Arena‑Ready Structure Ideal for one‑day tournaments, SMP showdowns, or community challenges. - Server‑Side Only Players join instantly — no downloads, no mod installations. - KubeJS‑Powered Logic A single script controls the entire system, making it easy to read, edit, or expand. - Modular by Design Add arenas, datapacks, or additional mechanics to shape your own version of the Games. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # **_🌍 How It Works_** - The moment a new player appears: - Their UUID is detected - An element is chosen at random - The assignment is saved - Their role in the arena is set - From that point on, every encounter becomes a question of adaptation. Who bends what? Who survives longer? Who learns faster? The arena doesn’t care — it only watches. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ # **_⚙️ Setup Instructions_**
Click to Expand Full Setup Guide Open Your Server Directory /kubejs/ Enter the Server Scripts Folder /kubejs/server_scripts/ Create a New Script File Elemental.js Paste the Elemental Script Open Elemental.js Script (Your link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-lTrE0kvnOilhhkzKkb-0gZp1ZdpABIdwPJX7okRK6A/edit?usp=sharing) Restart Your Server The system activates automatically. New players will receive their element on first join.
